features.description: Physical lines after universal-newline normalization and outer whitespace trimming.
features.name: physical_lines

features.description: UTF-8 byte length of the normalized function snippet.
features.name: function_bytes

features.description: Declared parameters of the function; void and variadic ellipsis excluded.
features.name: parameter_count

features.description: if statements, switch statements and ternary expressions.
features.name: conditional_count

features.description: Maximum nested if/switch/loop/ternary nodes; else-if adds a level.
features.name: max_nesting_depth

features.description: 1 + if + loops + non-default case labels + ternaries + logical &&/|| operators.
features.name: decision_complexity

features.description: Pointer declarators, unary address/dereference expressions, and -> member accesses.
features.name: pointer_syntax_count

features.description: Call-expression syntax nodes; macros resembling calls may be included.
features.name: call_count

missing_values: NaN; fit median imputation on training rows only, retaining all-empty columns.
parsing_policy: Exactly one function definition and no Tree-sitter errors; otherwise structural values are unavailable. Lexical values remain available for nonempty text.
